headline: One cell type
punch: AND IT EMPTIES FASTER THAN YOU THINK

headline: At the top
body: of your growth plate sits a thin layer called the *resting zone*. | The name is wrong. They are not resting, they are the reserve. | They divide slowly, and every division makes the columns that lengthen bone.
punch: Everything below them is the production line.

headline: They are marked
body: by a protein called *PTHrP*. | Single cell sequencing of **human** pubertal growth plate biopsies confirmed two distinct populations. | Not inferred from mice. Found in people.
punch: This stopped being a mouse story in 2025.

headline: And they run out
body: In rabbits, over **95%** of resting zone cells were dividing at birth. | By **17 weeks** that dropped under **10%**. | The cell count fell as well, not just the activity.
punch: Fewer cells and less active. It empties both ways.

headline: Which is what
body: running out of height actually means. | Not a hormone declining. Not a clock hitting zero. | A specific population of stem cells exhausting a finite number of divisions.
punch: This is the thing you are actually spending.

headline: You can push them
body: One *Hedgehog agonist* bead implanted in a single rat femur. | Produced a measurable, growing length difference against the untreated leg. | Same animal. Same genetics. One leg longer.
punch: The reserve responds if you signal it.

headline: They need a niche
body: These cells only stay stem like in a **low Wnt** environment. | Force canonical Wnt signalling on and they lose the ability to form columns at all. | The environment is a requirement, not background.
punch: Wrong signal and the cells stop being what they are.

headline: Growth hormone
body: hits them directly. | GH stimulates human resting zone cells through *JAK/STAT* and local *TGF beta*. | Completely separate from the liver IGF-1 pathway everyone measures.
punch: The GH story has a half nobody covers.

headline: Which is why
body: serum IGF-1 misleads you. | It reports liver output. | It says nothing about what your resting zone is actually sitting in.
punch: The measurable number is not the relevant one.

headline: Estrogen
body: depletes this population **structurally**. | Not suppressed. Depleted. Still measurable five weeks after treatment stopped. | Growth rate suppression reverses. Cell loss does not.
punch: One is a pause. The other is permanent.

headline: And this is why
body: catch up growth works at all. | Slow the division rate and the reserve depletes slower. | Release it and there is more capacity left than there should be.

headline: The honest gap
body: Nobody has directly tested whether normal fusion **is** these cells clonally exhausting. | It is the best model available and it remains inference. | The cellular mechanism of fusion has four competing theories and zero confirmed in humans.
punch: Best explanation available is not the same as proven.
